name: robot-shift-field-manual
description: A practical 180-day robotics curriculum and AI tutor.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs && node --import tsx --test tests/chapter-content.test.mjs tests/curriculum-content.test.mjs tests/career-market.test.mjs tests/visual-content.test.mjs tests/mission-progress.test.mjs tests/interactive-math.test.mjs tests/theme.test.mjs tests/rich-text.test.tsx tests/lesson-media.test.ts tests/storage-migrations.test.ts tests/firebase-auth.test.ts tests/cloud-persistence.test.ts
scripts.test:auth-emulator: env -i PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" LANG="${LANG:-C.UTF-8}" npm_config_cache="${npm_config_cache:-$HOME/.npm}" GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/nonexistent/robotshift-emulator-no-credentials.json NO_COLOR=1 CI=1 npx --yes firebase-tools@15.24.0 emulators:exec --project demo-robotshift --only auth "npm run test:auth-emulator:inside"
scripts.test:firestore-rules: if [ -x /opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/bin/java ]; then export JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21; fi; env -i PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" LANG="${LANG:-C.UTF-8}" JAVA_HOME="$JAVA_HOME" npm_config_cache="${npm_config_cache:-$HOME/.npm}" FIREBASE_EMULATORS_PATH="${FIREBASE_EMULATORS_PATH:-$HOME/.cache/firebase/emulators}" GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/nonexistent/robotshift-emulator-no-credentials.json NO_COLOR=1 CI=1 npx --yes firebase-tools@15.24.0 emulators:exec --project demo-robotshift --only firestore "npm run test:firestore-rules:inside"
scripts.test:functions-emulator: npm --prefix functions run build && if [ -x /opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/bin/java ]; then export JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21; fi; env -i PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" LANG="${LANG:-C.UTF-8}" JAVA_HOME="$JAVA_HOME" npm_config_cache="${npm_config_cache:-$HOME/.npm}" FIREBASE_EMULATORS_PATH="${FIREBASE_EMULATORS_PATH:-$HOME/.cache/firebase/emulators}" GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/nonexistent/robotshift-emulator-no-credentials.json NO_COLOR=1 CI=1 FIREBASE_DEBUG_MODE=true FIREBASE_DEBUG_FEATURES='{"skipTokenVerification":true}' FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:5001 npx --yes firebase-tools@15.24.0 emulators:exec --project demo-robotshift --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run test:functions-emulator:inside"
scripts.test:firebase-emulators: npm run test:auth-emulator && npm run test:firestore-rules && npm run test:functions-emulator
